name: PrismaticBurst-TS-TW
blurb: Raymarched prismatic bursts with configurable colors, animation modes, and optional cursor tracking.
description: WebGL shader rendering procedurally-generated colorful rays radiating from a central point. Supports continuous rotation, 3D orbit, or cursor-responsive hover mode. Distortion and ray-count controls modulate the effect intensity.
use_when: Hero sections, visual centerpieces, or backgrounds where a vibrant, energetic prismatic burst commands attention.
avoid_when: WebGL-unsupported devices, touch-only surfaces (hover mode), performance-critical mobile — raymarching is compute-intensive.
a11y: Passive visual background; no keyboard interaction or focus states. Does not respect prefers-reduced-motion.
